WHO is aware of and supporting a public health event involving a cruise vessel sailing in the Atlantic Ocean. To date, one case of hantavirus infection has been laboratory confirmed, and there are five additional suspected cases. Of the six affected individuals, three have died and one is currently in intensive care in South Africa. Detailed investigations are ongoing, including further laboratory testing, and epidemiological investigations. Medical care and support are being provided to passengers and crew. Sequencing of the virus is also ongoing. Hantavirus infections are typically linked to environmental exposure (exposure to infected rodents’ urine or faeces). While rare, hantavirus may spread between people, and can lead to severe respiratory illness and requires careful patient monitoring, support and response. WHO is facilitating coordination between Member States and the Ship’s operators for medical evacuation of two symptomatic passengers, as well as full public health risk assessment and support to the remaining passengers on board. WHO is grateful for the rapid actions and coordination. We have informed our National Focal Points according to the International Health Regulations and a Disease Outbreak News for the public will be issued.

JetBlue just pulled the ultimate power move. Hours after Spirit Airlines went dark, JetBlue swooped into South Florida with a full-blown rescue mission—and they're not playing small. Blue Basic is capped at $299 through May 8. But that's just the warm-up. JetBlue is exploding at Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood International—adding 11 brand new cities, extra flights on existing routes, and pushing nearly 130 daily departures this summer. That's a 75%+ jump from last year and their biggest FLL operation EVER. CEO Joanna Geraghty put it plainly: "South Florida is a key market... we're stepping up, adding service, and keeping fares competitive." (Translation: we're taking over.) Fun fact? Fort Lauderdale was JetBlue's very first destination back in 2000. Now they're reclaiming it after Spirit held 27% of that market. Oh, and they're not leaving Spirit's crew behind either—jumpseat access for two weeks and job interviews for qualified staff. This is how you turn a market collapse into a masterclass. 👇

On World Press Freedom Day, we thank every journalist, photographer, fixer, editor, and media worker who continues to tell the world the truth about Ukraine. Ukrainian and foreign journalists document Russia's war crimes, report from frontline cities, and preserve the stories of people living through this war. Many risk their lives to make sure the truth is seen and heard. Some have paid for it with their freedom or their lives. This year, Ukraine rose seven places in the World Press Freedom Index by Reporters Without Borders, reaching 55th place among 180 countries. Since the start of Russia's full-scale invasion, Ukraine has climbed 50 positions in the ranking. At the same time, Russia continues persecuting journalists for doing their work, with 26 Ukrainian media workers currently held captive. They must be released and returned home. Free journalism is one of the most powerful tools against propaganda, disinformation and attempts to hide the truth. Thank you to everyone who continues to report, document, investigate and speak up.

Alors que les rivalités autour du détroit de Bab-el-Mandeb s’accentuent, cet article explique la centralité stratégique de Mayyun, devenue un point de rivalité décisif entre acteurs régionaux et internationaux. turkish intelligence (@turkish_intell) Mayyun Island: a discreet strategic chokepoint at the heart of major rivalries in the Red Sea Mayyun Island, located at the heart of the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, is now emerging as a pivotal node in the strategic rivalries shaping the Red Sea. This volcanic outcrop is drawing increasing attention from regional and international powers due to its capacity to control, or disrupt, one of the world’s most critical maritime trade routes. Since early April, several Western intelligence services have requested satellite imagery acquisitions from Airbus Defence and Space, specifically targeting Mayyun. This renewed interest comes amid heightened tensions between anti-Houthi factions, particularly between the internationally recognized Yemeni government (backed by Riyadh) and forces affiliated with Tareq Saleh, nephew of Ali Abdullah Saleh. Long supported by Abu Dhabi, Tareq Saleh is now attracting Washington’s attention, signaling a possible realignment of external backing. A revealing episode illustrates these frictions: on April 1, military transport aircraft reportedly attempted to land on the island but were prevented from doing so by pro-Saudi forces. While this account was officially denied, OSINT analyses nevertheless confirmed the suspicious passage, the previous evening, of an Ilyushin Il-76 (registration TL-ATD), which circled above Mayyun before heading back toward Africa. The aircraft is operated by Invicta Air Cargo, a Central African company with structural ties to Emirati security networks, notably through Gewan Holding, which is close to Hamdan bin Zayed al-Nahyan, brother of President Mohammed bin Zayed al-Nahyan. Technical connections between the two entities (including the reuse of digital infrastructure and transfers of aviation assets) suggest operational continuity. Notably, a few days after flying over Mayyun, the aircraft traveled from Fujairah to the Israeli Nevatim airbase, pointing to broader, and potentially coordinated, logistical circuits. On the ground, the control dynamics over the island have evolved. Initially, Abu Dhabi had been developing discreet air infrastructure there, progress of which was still visible in commercial satellite imagery in 2025. However, since early 2026, the UAE appears to have withdrawn. This shift is part of a broader reassertion of control by Riyadh over local forces (notably those of the Southern Transitional Council), thereby consolidating its direct influence. Currently, control of Mayyun rests on a combination of Tareq Saleh’s forces and a significant Saudi contingent, particularly deployed around the island’s airstrip. However, the aforementioned aerial incident suggests that coordination between these actors remains imperfect, if not openly strained. Moreover, several local sources indicate a deepening of security cooperation between Saudi Arabia, the United States, and Israel on the island. Narratives disseminated by the Houthis had already, as early as February, pointed to joint projects aimed at transforming Mayyun into a forward strategic platform. The objective appears clear: to establish a foothold capable of containing, or countering, any attempt by the Iran-backed Houthis to blockade the strait, echoing recurring tensions in the Strait of Hormuz. Finally, the gradual withdrawal of the UAE from its insular positions in Yemen (notably Socotra and Mayyun) now seems nearly complete. According to several security sources, their last active foothold would be Abd al-Kuri Island in the Indian Ocean, marking a strategic repositioning in response to Saudi Arabia’s growing assertiveness. In sum, Mayyun stands out as a true geostrategic chokepoint, where intra-coalition rivalries, shifting alliances, and power projection dynamics converge. Control over this small island far exceeds its size: it directly shapes the security balance of a maritime corridor that is vital on a global scale. — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/turkish_intell/status/2047310600368230638#m

excellent and important post Russell Blackford (@Metamagician) I wonder how many people have actually read Lemkin's chapter on genocide. If you read it, you'll find that he wanted to use the word in a way that was much broader than either its popular or its legal meaning. Lemkin fought for his broad meaning after World War II, but by the time of the Genocide Convention a much narrower meaning - a subset of the very worst of what Lemkin had in mind - became the meaning that prevailed. The thing is, you can't have it both ways. What makes genocide so horrifying is that it's a (serious) effort at physically exterminating an entire people, or at least the entirety of them who are in your power. Contrary to what Lemkin had in mind - and even Lemkin admitted there were conceptual problems with this - it doesn't mean cultural assimilation of the people of a nation you've conquered, such as efforts by the Nazis to "Germanify" Poland. We can praise Lemkin for actually coining the word, but no one now uses it the way he originally wanted, and that's a good thing. As a result of the wrangling in the late 1940s, we have a perfectly good word that stands for the crime of crimes: an attempt at physically exterminating the people of an ethnic, racial, religious, or national group, as Hitler attempted (with considerable success) with the Jews of Europe. It doesn't mean being the more powerful participant in an asymmetrical war; it doesn't mean breaching IHL; it doesn't even mean large-scale war crimes. It means something more specific, the very worst of the worst of international crimes, with the Holocaust as the paradigm. The concomitant of all this is that the word, with its suggestion of ultimate evil, should not be thrown around loosely. If we want to say that someone has gone to war in circumstances that will inevitably lead to a lot of civilian deaths, we can say that (and we're entitled to be critical of it if we think there was an alternative). If we think someone has committed war crimes such as aerial bombardment deliberately targeting civilians (as happened on both sides during World War II), we can say that. There are lots of things we can say to make very serious accusations connected with war. But genocide is something beyond any of that, and its connection to the supreme evil of the Holocaust in the popular understanding should not be taken lightly. When someone makes an accusation of genocide that clearly doesn't match either the popular understanding or the legal definition, you know you're dealing with someone who is either a propagandist who is deliberately lying or someone who is simply ignorant of what the term means. I assume that it's usually the latter - there are many well-intentioned people who are not knowledgeable about any of this and can be swayed by others who seem like experts - but there's also plenty of the former around. — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/Metamagician/status/2050379307848216803#m

America stopped making titanium sponge in 2020. China and Russia produce 75% of the world's supply. Two Japanese companies, Toho Titanium and Osaka Titanium, supply 70% of America's imports. Sponge is the porous metallic form that every titanium part starts as. In 2018, Titanium Metals Corporation warned regulators that without tariffs the US military would depend on geopolitically risky countries for titanium. No tariffs came. Two years later their plant closed. This month the Air Force announced an $8.4 million program to 3D-print titanium aerostructures. The sponge still comes from overseas. I manufacture chemicals. The same molecular structure that lets titanium survive the most corrosive reactors in our industry is the structure that punishes you when you try to shape it. It conducts heat 30 times slower than aluminum. Machine it and three problems feed each other. The heat stays at the tool tip. The metal bonds to the cutting tool. The surface hardens the moment the tool touches it. Each cut hits a tougher surface than the one before. Aerospace-grade titanium has no substitute. Nothing else matches its strength-to-weight at jet-engine temperatures. Every F-35, Falcon 9, and chlorine plant depends on a metal the US imports.

Good thread, though I am somewhat less pessimistic about what this means for Germany and Europe. The number of all-up rounds deployed as part of MDTF to Europe was always going to be low, as was the salvo size generated by the associated strike capabilities. They would no doubt have been useful for warfighting, but the overall operational impact would have been limited. What Germany and other European governments had really hoped for was that this would constitute some form of escalation management tool, capable of holding sensitive Russian targets at risk. Whether the United States would have been willing to use them in that way was always questionable. In the end, there is no alternative to a European solution for Europe, independent of American presidential decision-making (whether it should also be independent of NATO command structures going forward is a question European states will have to settle in the near future). On the kill chain: yes, Germany and Europe need to invest across the board. But Germany's investments in ISR, particularly in space-based systems, are largely satisfactory in my view. With the SPOCK 1 constellation, Germany will achieve ~40 to 60-minute revisit rates over the Baltic theater by 2028 -- that's good enough for Germany's needs. What Germany and Europe need are missiles, missiles, and more missiles. excellent and important post Russell Blackford (@Metamagician) I wonder how many people have actually read Lemkin's chapter on genocide. If you read it, you'll find that he wanted to use the word in a way that was much broader than either its popular or its legal meaning. Lemkin fought for his broad meaning after World War II, but by the time of the Genocide Convention a much narrower meaning - a subset of the very worst of what Lemkin had in mind - became the meaning that prevailed. The thing is, you can't have it both ways. What makes genocide so horrifying is that it's a (serious) effort at physically exterminating an entire people, or at least the entirety of them who are in your power. Contrary to what Lemkin had in mind - and even Lemkin admitted there were conceptual problems with this - it doesn't mean cultural assimilation of the people of a nation you've conquered, such as efforts by the Nazis to "Germanify" Poland. We can praise Lemkin for actually coining the word, but no one now uses it the way he originally wanted, and that's a good thing. As a result of the wrangling in the late 1940s, we have a perfectly good word that stands for the crime of crimes: an attempt at physically exterminating the people of an ethnic, racial, religious, or national group, as Hitler attempted (with considerable success) with the Jews of Europe. It doesn't mean being the more powerful participant in an asymmetrical war; it doesn't mean breaching IHL; it doesn't even mean large-scale war crimes. It means something more specific, the very worst of the worst of international crimes, with the Holocaust as the paradigm. The concomitant of all this is that the word, with its suggestion of ultimate evil, should not be thrown around loosely. If we want to say that someone has gone to war in circumstances that will inevitably lead to a lot of civilian deaths, we can say that (and we're entitled to be critical of it if we think there was an alternative). If we think someone has committed war crimes such as aerial bombardment deliberately targeting civilians (as happened on both sides during World War II), we can say that. There are lots of things we can say to make very serious accusations connected with war. But genocide is something beyond any of that, and its connection to the supreme evil of the Holocaust in the popular understanding should not be taken lightly. When someone makes an accusation of genocide that clearly doesn't match either the popular understanding or the legal definition, you know you're dealing with someone who is either a propagandist who is deliberately lying or someone who is simply ignorant of what the term means. I assume that it's usually the latter - there are many well-intentioned people who are not knowledgeable about any of this and can be swayed by others who seem like experts - but there's also plenty of the former around. — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/Metamagician/status/2050379307848216803#m

Religious Scholars Are Those Whom Allah Has Made Witnesses to His Oneness: Shaykh-ul-Islam Dr. Muhammad Tahir-ul-Qadri Addresses Scholarly Gathering in Oslo Oslo, Norway: His Eminence Shaykh-ul-Islam Dr. Muhammad Tahir-ul-Qadri and Prof. Dr. Hassan Mohiuddin Qadri, Chairman Supreme Council of Minhaj-ul-Quran International, participated in a special scholarly session organized in honor of religious scholars at the Islamic Center Minhaj-ul-Quran International, Oslo. On this occasion, Shaykh-ul-Islam delivered a detailed address on the virtues and responsibilities of religious scholars. He stated that religious scholars are, in reality, those distinguished personalities whom Almighty Allah has made witnesses to His Oneness and truth. He emphasized that their true identity lies in being “Qaim bil-Qist”—those who remain steadfast upon justice and fairness at all times and never deviate from the demands of justice in any matter. While continuing his address, Shaykh-ul-Islam stressed that scholarly discourse must always be based on sound research and strong evidence. Explaining the proper order of scholarly reasoning, he stated that priority must first be given to the Holy Qur’an, followed by the Prophetic Hadith (peace and blessings be upon him), then Ijma (consensus) and Qiyas (analogical reasoning), and finally Ijtihad and personal opinion, as maintaining this order is essential for preserving academic and scholarly standards. During the session, Shaykh-ul-Islam also responded to various scholarly and research-based questions raised by the participants. The gathering was attended by a large number of scholars from different schools of thought, including Mufti Tahir Aziz, Hafiz Sadaqat Ali Qadri, Hafiz Safdar Ali, Qari Ansar Ali Qadri, Mufti Zubair Tabassum, Allama Arshad Zia, Haroon Qayyum, Allama Kaukab Noorani, Allama Muhammad Jameel Mortensrud, Allama Najeeb-ur-Rehman Naz, Allama Naseer Ahmad Noori, Allama Noor Ahmad Noor, Syed Nehmat Ali Shah, Syed Firasat Ali Bukhari, Qari Muhammad Aslam, Qari Israr Ahmad, Qari Jahangir Drammen, Qari Mahmood-ul-Hasan, Qari Noor Ali Sialvi, Syed Zawar Hussain Naqvi, Qari Rehmat Ilahi, Syed Shamshad Rizvi, Allama Hamid Farooq, Allama Nasir Ali, Qari Shiraz Madani, Syed Hasnain Gilani, Qari Ahmad Bilal Shah, Allama Inam Awan, Qari Zia-ul-Hasnain, Masoom Zubair, Syed Hassan Rizvi, Allama Saleem Alvi, Allama Javed, Allama Bashir Ahmad, Allama Ateeq-ur-Rehman, Allama Abid Kashmiri, Faisal Qayyum, Syed Bilal Imtiaz Shah, Qari Syed Farid, and many other scholars and spiritual leaders from Oslo and surrounding areas. Representatives from MQI Norway were also present, including Imam and Director MQI Norway Allama Muhammad Iqbal Fani, Afzal Ansari (Ameer-e-Tehreek), Awais Ejaz Ahmed (President), Chaudhry Mushtaq Ahmed (President Rabita Committee and Vice President MQI), Zartash Bashir (Vice President), Hassan Bashir (General Secretary MQI), Atif Rauf (Finance Secretary), Ata-ul-Mustafa Mahmood (Joint Secretary), Pervaiz Nisar (Head, House of Representatives MQI), Arfan Ansari (President MQI Oslo), Sheikh Iftikhar (Vice President), Muhammad Nazim Ali (General Secretary), Fahad Nisar (Joint Secretary), and Executive Board members including Rauf Hussain, Atique Sial, Shuaib Saleem, and Sabir Hussain.

My leader @ImranKhanPTI sits in jail with his health in jeopardy. His imprisonment weighs on us every day. But I know him well enough to say this: He would want Pakistan's young people to keep building, to take on the world. Especially in AI. Especially now, without losing sight of the political struggle, which we will not abandon. This thread is for them 🧵 — Forced to stay away from my country gave me two benefits: More time and more passion. I chose not to waste either. This is a personal account: It started with my need to transcribe my long speeches, some over thirty minutes, in mixed English and Urdu on YouTube (which gave a Hindi/Sanskrit transcript). The platforms available would do a bad job with the mix. So, I asked my coaches — ChatGPT, Claude & Gemini and I concluded to do it myself, locally, with Whisper’s large, medium & small models and other AI tools. This was completed in Dec ‘25 For the sake of open source and transparency, I am publishing it on GitHub. github.com/DrArifAlvi/youtub… In January ’26, I began building the Dr Arif Alvi AI Archive. An attempt to bring together everything I had said, written, read, and recorded across decades, and make it searchable, synthesizable, MINE. I built it alone. No team. No budget. Just time, curiosity, and persistence. It runs entirely on my enhanced laptop. My data never leaves it. My AI agents ingest my writings/articles; thousands of books read and summarised; millions of words of archival material; my thousands of speeches on YouTube press conferences; thousands of talk show appearances since 2000 and clips on YouTube. All scraped from the net via APIs— indexed, and alive inside my local RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) system that answers back. My 50,000+ tweets are searchable faster than X's own tools. Not just by keyword but semantically. None of it leaves my computer or enters the public domain, remains private. — The local LLMs answer questions, draft research briefs, synthesize across all data. When I need to reach beyond my own archive, they augment from public LLMs — ChatGPT, Claude, DeepSeek, others. I use the archive every day, updating it regularly. It has changed how I think and work. — Following are the layers of the stack — what I built is one-of-one. But what I built it from is available to every-one: ▶️ Ollama / Llama / Phi / Qwen — local LLMs running entirely on-device ▶️ Whisper — bilingual English-Urdu speech transcription ▶️ ChromaDB — vector memory across 70,000+ chunks ▶️ Sentence Transformers — semantic search across tweets, speeches, and archives ▶️ Streamlit — dashboard with dual modes: semantic search and AI research ▶️ Six LLM interfaces (ChatGPT, Claude, DeepSeek, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot) for python scripts and for augmentation of local output ▶️ OpenClaw and GitHub — for code management ▶️VS Code — for scripts and code writing None of them are mine. The COMPOSITION is mine. — I should tell you what it took to get here. I started learning Python basics from online courses. I am not a programmer, but I reviewed and iterated over a million lines of scripts —learning, correcting, improving, understanding—just enough to keep going. I had launched Pakistan's Presidential Initiative on Artificial Intelligence in 2019. I thought I understood AI but I took advanced courses anyway. There is always more to learn, and humility about ignorance is not a weakness. It is the only honest starting point. — There are tens of thousands of students, researchers, operators, lawyers, and doctors across Pakistan and the world, quietly trying to dabble in AI right now. To them I would say: software writing is mostly done by machines today. You do not need to become a programmer. You need to understand enough to read, direct, correct and employ tools — like a symphony conductor, with an AI baton. More than anything, pick a project. Something real, something yours.🔑 Scripts fill the architecture. Concrete fills the blueprint. GET TO WORK And do not move slowly. AI tools and agentic systems are changing every single day. What was remarkable yesterday is ordinary today. Sometimes the gap is hours, not months. The people who stay ahead are not waiting to fully understand it before they begin. THEY ARE ALREADY BUILDING. — Pakistan cannot afford to fall behind in this. Not out of nostalgia for what Pakistan was, but out of economic and strategic urgency for what it must become — because our talented, hungry people can build anything when given the tools and the leadership. This is for them. START

CASO DALMASSO: QUÉ DECÍAN LOS INFORMES DEL FBI QUE AHORA SON CLAVE EN EL JURY CONTRA LOS FISCALES ACUSADOS DE MAL DESEMPEÑO En 2009, agentes del FBI viajaron a Córdoba para colaborar en la investigación del crimen de Nora Dalmasso, ante la falta de avances en la causa. Analizaron la escena, los informes y elaboraron dos documentos que hoy resultan centrales en el proceso disciplinario contra los fiscales acusados de negligencia. El primer informe, del Centro Nacional para el Análisis de Crímenes Violentos del FBI, reconstruyó el perfil y la rutina de la víctima, descartó móviles económicos o personales y determinó que el crimen tuvo motivación sexual y fue cometido por un autor solitario que conocía la casa. El FBI destacó que el asesino sabía que Nora Dalmasso estaría sola esa noche y probablemente ingresó por una puerta trasera o un balcón, sin forzar accesos. Sugirió profundizar en el análisis de ADN, investigar a fondo a los trabajadores que estuvieron en la casa y revisar antecedentes penales y posibles conductas sospechosas. El segundo informe, de 2010, correspondió al análisis de ADN realizado en Estados Unidos. Concluyó que no se podía identificar con certeza a los donantes por la mezcla de perfiles genéticos y no se detectó ADN de Gastón Zárate en la escena. Sí se encontraron dos perfiles masculinos no identificados y se descartó a otros 26 individuos analizados. Los informes del FBI, sus advertencias y recomendaciones, son ahora pieza fundamental en el jury que analiza la actuación de los fiscales que llevaron la causa durante años y que podrían ser destituidos por mal desempeño. At the recent roundtable on "Protected Cultivation as a Strategy for Crop Diversification and Income Growth", #ICRIER brought together policymakers, researchers, farmers and industry experts to discuss pathways for scaling high-value agriculture in India, and the consensus was clear that the future of Indian agriculture lies beyond wheat and paddy. Setting the context, Dr #AshokGulati, Distinguished Professor, ICRIER, framed the central paradox: if polyhouses can deliver 3–5x higher productivity and 30–50x better income returns than traditional paddy-wheat systems, why does adoption remain near zero? The discussions pointed to what needs to shift: ✅Starting with clustered, high-potential geographies — Bassi-Boraj in Rajasthan and Kutch in Gujarat show what's possible ✅Building financing models that match the investment horizon of polyhouse farming ✅Strengthening FPOs to give smallholders collective market power ✅ Investing in cold chains, logistics, and post-harvest infrastructure The event also marked the launch of ICRIER's report "Augmenting Farmers' Income through Protected Cultivation", authored by Dr Ranjana Roy and Dr #AshokGulati, which makes the case that the shift from cereal-based systems to high-value horticulture won't happen through technology alone, it requires coordinated policy support, better credit access, and a fundamental rethink of how farming systems are designed. Protected cultivation holds transformative potential. Unlocking it will take aligning technology, markets, and policy together. 🔗 Read the full report: icrier.org/publications/augm… #Agriculture #FoodSecurity #ProtectedCultivation #PolicyResearch #ICRIER #AgriTech #FarmerIncome

ADORNI Y DESPUÉS: MILEI ADOCTRINÓ AL GABINETE A LA ESPERA DE LA RECUPERACIÓN ECONÓMICA El Gobierno cortó una racha de casi dos meses de parálisis institucional con la presentación de Manuel Adorni en el Congreso. Javier Milei reforzó el verticalismo en su gabinete, priorizando la lealtad por encima de las dificultades judiciales de sus funcionarios. Karina Milei asumió el rol de organizadora política y permitió el lanzamiento electoral de Patricia Bullrich en CABA y Diego Santilli en la provincia de Buenos Aires, en un intento por mostrar al oficialismo en carrera tras el desgaste generado por el caso Adorni. La exposición de Adorni dejó en evidencia la fractura interna y el deterioro en el vínculo con la sociedad, acentuado por encuestas que muestran una desaprobación del 63% y un apoyo en caída. El PRO se mantuvo al margen, mientras el centro político y los representantes provinciales quedaron ausentes del debate, lo que agrava el “vacío de representación” en sectores que alguna vez acompañaron las reformas del Gobierno. En el terreno económico, el Ejecutivo espera que la liquidación de la cosecha y el crédito externo permitan un trimestre más favorable, aunque la recuperación es lenta y los números siguen mostrando debilidad en la actividad, el empleo y el consumo. Las provincias enfrentan déficits crecientes y el oficialismo no logra avances legislativos de peso en el Congreso. El centro político y la oposición peronista aprovechan el desgaste oficial, pero siguen sin alcanzar la mayoría para forzar cambios. El Gobierno, mientras tanto, se aferra a la expectativa de una mejora económica que le permita recuperar la iniciativa. Infobae: infob.ae/4tQ8nQx

King Charles III quietly did something genuinely moving during his state visit to the United States. A lifelong environmentalist who has championed conservation for over five decades often at the cost of ridicule from the British press the King ended his trip by visiting Shenandoah National Park in Virginia. There, he sat with park rangers, swore in a new group of Junior Rangers, met Buddy the bald eagle, and unveiled a new partnership between Shenandoah and Scotland’s Cairngorms National Park. This is the same man who converted his own estate to organic farming back in 1986, long before it was fashionable. A foreign monarch showing up with real curiosity and respect for America’s public lands felt refreshingly sincere. And yet, it barely made a headline. That silence is telling. When a visiting head of state reminds us of the value of our own national parks more visibly than our own leadership, something has gone wrong. For decades, King Charles has put his credibility on the line for the natural world. Meanwhile, America’s public lands have faced aggressive rollbacks: the weakening of protections like the Roadless Rule, opening tens of millions of acres of national forests to logging and mining, and efforts to sell off large portions to private interests. It’s a stark contrast. One man has spent a lifetime planting trees and defending nature. The other treats the outdoors primarily as a backdrop for golf courses. Our public lands deserve better than being viewed as a development opportunity. They belong to all of us and they’re worth protecting, not selling.

Human rights activist Greta Thunberg has condemned Israel’s illegal interception of more than 20 civilian vessels from the Global Flotilla in international waters, saying around 200 participants were taken over 1,000 kilometres from Gaza during the operation. In a video statement, she said many of those detained were later released in Crete after being injured, with some requiring hospital treatment, and described coordination between Israeli and Greek authorities. She said at least two activists remain in Israeli custody after being forcibly taken to Israel, where she stated they are being tortured, and that they are being held on fabricated accusations linked to their Palestine solidarity activism. Thunberg called for their immediate release and said their detention reflects broader practices against Palestinians held without charge. She urged Sweden, Spain and Brazil to intervene, and called on the international community to act urgently. Video

Commentary by Ambassador of Russia to Israel Anatoly Viktorov on the anniversary of the Tragedy in Odessa Today marks the 12th anniversary of the horrific crime committed in Odessa by supporters of the coup d’état in Ukraine. From spring 2014, Odessa dwellers set up a tent camp on the square near the Trade Unions House, where they held lawful demonstrations in support of federalization of Ukraine, preservation of the region’s historical and cultural heritage, protection of the Russian language, in opposition to so-called Euromaidan. On 2 May 2014 young belligerent thugs, as it later turned out armed ones, were brought into the city from other regions of the country. They attacked peaceful protesters and destroyed the anti-Maidan camp. Some of the activists tried to take shelter inside the Trade Unions House. However, the ideological heirs of Petliura, Bandera, Shukhevych and other current Ukrainian “heroes” , smelling blood, set the building on fire. Those who jumped out of windows to escape the flames were brutally beaten to death on the ground. As a result, according to official figures alone, at least 48 people were burned alive, died from smoke inhalation or fell to their deaths from the upper floors. Many of them had gunshot wounds. Children were among the dead. Dozens of people suffered injuries and disabilities. The strong rejection of the Bandera-inspired Ukrainian neo-Nazism and nationalism that was shown by the freedom-loving Russian-speaking residents of Odessa is deeply rooted in history. Odessa is a historical “melting pot” where the fates of Russians, Jews, Ukrainians and many other nations are closely intertwined. The city became one of the largest centers of Jewish life, culture and education in the Russian Empire and in the world. However, as a result of the German-Romanian occupation in 1941-1944, it virtually lost its Jewish community, which was tortured in the flames of the Holocaust. Nevertheless, the Jews of Odessa did not give up, many participated in the partisan movement and the city defence in the ranks of the Red Army, eventually reaching Berlin in May 1945. They also were actively involved in the city life in recent decades. Among the victims of the Tragedy on 2 May 2014 there were the Odessans of the Jewish origin. As long as Zelensky’s clique remains in power in Kiev, there is no hope for a fair investigation into the events in Odessa. Nevertheless, we are firmly convinced that perpetrators and instigators of this barbaric crime, which has no statute of limitations, will face just punishment. We will not forget, we will not forgive!

On 27 April, eight wounded children from Gaza, along with their caregivers, arrived in Amman, Jordan, to our reconstructive surgery hospital. They were medically evacuated in collaboration with the Jordanian Ministry of Health, and are the first patients to arrive in three months due to the regional conflict. The children are suffering from complex injuries caused by Israeli airstrikes, including fractures and infections. Among them is Rafeef, 17 years old, who requires a second leg amputation due to his injuries. He was unable to receive the specialised care he needs in Gaza, as the health system has been destroyed. “We have been waiting for months for these patients,” says Dr Feras, MSF’s medical referral coordinator at the hospital. “Evacuations stalled after the borders closed. Seraj, 11, waited over a year for his approval. His complex injuries required an additional ambulance for safe transfer.” Medical evacuations from Gaza are still hampered by administrative barriers. The number of people able to leave the Strip remains a drop in the ocean compared to the needs. According to the WHO, 18,500 critical patients, including 4,000 children, still require urgent evacuation from Gaza. We call on the Israeli authorities to ensure medical evacuations for all Palestinians, while ensuring patients and caregivers a safe, voluntary and dignified return to Gaza. The siege must be lifted to allow lifesaving aid to reach those who need it.

افراد کو انکی بے لوث خدمات پر خراج تحسین پیش کرتا ہوں۔ صحافت سے وابستہ افراد کی پیشہ ورانہ فرائض کی انجام دہی ایک باخبر اور با شعور معاشرے کی ضمانت ہے۔ مستند اور تعصب سے پاک غیر جانبدارانہ خبروں کی سماجی اقدار کے امین ہیں۔ اس سال عالمی یومِ آزادیِ صحافت *“پرامن مستقبل کی تشکیل”* کے عنوان تحت منایا جارہا ہے۔ یہ موضوع دور حاضر کی ضروریات کی عکاسی کرتا ہے۔ صحافی اپنے فرائض کی انجام دہی میں ایک باوقار، باحفاظت اور سازگار ماحول کے حقدار ہیں۔ عصر حاضر میں امن و امان کا ماحول محض سفارت کاری سے حاصل نہیں ہوتا بلکہ مستند معلومات، ذمہ دارانہ صحافت اور عوامی راۓ اسکی تشکیل میں فیصلہ کن کردار ادا کرتی ہیں۔ بین الاقوامی تعلقات، ممالک کے مابین سفارتی,معاشی، معاشرتی باہمی تعلق کو مثبت، بامعنی اور موثر بنانے میں میڈیا تعمیری کردار ادا کرنے کی صلاحیت رکھتا ہے۔ بیشتر اوقات نقطہء نظر کی صحیح ترجمانی بہت سے پیچیدہ مسائل حل کر دیتی ہے۔ یہی ذمہ دارانہ صحافت کا طرہ امتیاز ہے۔ پاکستان پر امن ملک ہے اور اختلاف راۓ سے لے کر کشیدگی کے دیر پا حل تک مکالمے اور مذاکرات کو ترجیح دیتا ہے۔ موجودہ حالات میں سفارتی میدان میں پاکستان، کشیدگی میں کمی، مکالمے کے فروغ اور خطے میں امن کی بحالی کے لیے مثبت کردار ادا کر رہا ہے۔ اس تناظر میں عالمی سطح پر میڈیا نے پاکستان کی تحسین کی ہے۔ سفارتی محاذ اور زمانہ امن کے علاوہ قومی میڈیا نے معرکۂ حق اور آپریشن بنیان المرصوص کے دوران بھی ایک اہم ذمہ داری ادا کی۔ مربوط قومی ردعمل اور خودمختاری کے دفاع میں قومی یکجہتی اور پاکستان کے مؤقف کو وضاحت اور تحمل کے ساتھ پیش ادا کرتی رہے گی تاکہ سازگار ماحول میں میڈیا سچائی کے ساتھ اپنی ذمہ داری نبھاتا رہے۔ اور مل کر ہم ایک مضبوط پاکستان کی تعمیر کے لیۓ محو عمل رہیں جو پر امن، پراعتماد اور عالمی سطح پر باوقار مقام رکھتا LA GLOBALIZACIÓN DEL MATE: LA ARGENTINA EMPIEZA A EXPORTAR YERBA A CHINA Y SUPERA A BRASIL DESPUÉS DE SIETE AÑOS La Argentina recuperó en 2025 el primer lugar global en exportaciones de yerba mate, tanto por volumen como por valor, tras siete años de prevalencia brasileña. Según el reporte anual del Instituto Nacional de la Yerba Mate (INYM) el país registró un despacho al exterior de 57.980.912 kilos, con ingresos que superaron los USD 116 millones y un precio promedio superior a los USD 1.930 por tonelada. Este desempeño histórico funcionó como el preámbulo ideal para el inicio de 2026, año en el que el sector logró finalmente activar canales directos hacia China para acelerar la inserción de la tradicional infusión nacional en el mercado asiático. El volumen de los envíos de yerba mate enviada al exterior en 2025 representó un crecimiento interanual del 32% respecto de 2024, un número histórico para el sector. En términos de producción interna, la Argentina elaboró 889.253.082 kilos de yerba mate durante el año, lo que significa que aproximadamente el 6,5% de ese total se destinó a la exportación, justo por encima de Brasil, que hasta 2024 había sido el principal exportador del rubro. In Paris, I participated at the #G7 Development Ministerial Meeting where I engaged in discussions on strengthening cooperation and advancing a more efficient financial architecture, one that reduces fragmentation and delivers faster, more impactful results for partner countries. In a special session, I spoke about strategies to build a more efficient financial architecture with practical steps to strengthen partner countries’ sovereignty and resilience. Development finance must be more disciplined and catalytic, anchored in clearer guidance on domestic resource mobilization, stronger private capital mobilization and the scaling of remittances and diaspora investment as a reliable channel for rural development. We also discussed how to reduce fragmentation and use concessional resources more strategically, through country-led platforms and stronger accountability. Rising macroeconomic pressures are affecting the poorest countries hardest, especially economies reliant on agriculture and rural sectors. This is where @IFAD focuses its investments at the first mile, working to de-risk rural economies and unlock sustainable growth. This is precisely when partnership-driven investments with multiplier effects matter most. #FinancingTheFirstMile #FiCSG7 #FamilyRemittances #G7Development

Beijing called the U.S. measures, imposed under two executive orders, an “unjustified” and “improper” use of extraterritorial law. The move puts multinational companies operating in both markets in direct legal conflict: compliance with U.S. sanctions now risks violating Chinese law, and vice versa. Global banks and firms with dollar exposure face secondary sanctions risk if they continue dealing with the affected refineries. Analysts describe the order as a significant step toward competing legal frameworks for global trade, accelerating the path to potential economic “decoupling” between the two powers. Com a morte de Raimundo Rodrigues Pereira neste sábado, o Brasil perde um de seus maiores jornalistas. Mesmo tendo sido perseguido e preso pela ditadura militar, nunca deixou de lutar pela democracia e pela liberdade de imprensa. E, o que é mais importante: nunca se calou. Depois de ter trabalhado nas principais revistas do país nos anos 1960, Raimundo ajudou a formar, na década seguinte, o que ficou conhecido como a “imprensa alternativa”. No início dos anos 1970, foi editor-chefe do semanário Opinião. E, em 1975, criou o jornal Movimento, um veículo inovador para sua época, sem ligação com grandes editoras. O primeiro a mostrar, em nível nacional, o que significava a luta sindical e por liberdade que empreendemos no ABC no final dos anos 70. E fez isso muito antes do que se chamava “a grande imprensa”. Quero enviar meu forte abraço para a família e os amigos de Raimundo Rodrigues Pereira. E também para seus colegas de trabalho e todos os jornalistas que foram inspirados por sua trajetória.

🚨BREAKING: The fiber cable sitting in your wall has been secretly listening to you. And researchers just proved it. Security researchers from Hong Kong Polytechnic University and the Chinese University of Hong Kong presented a fully working attack at NDSS Symposium 2026 turning ordinary fiber optic internet cables into hidden, undetectable microphones. No laser bugs. No physical implants. No drilling through walls. Just the broadband cable already sitting in your living room or office. How It Actually Works: Optical fibers are sensitive to tiny vibrations. When sound waves travel through the air, they cause microscopic changes in the shape of the fiber. These changes alter the light signals traveling inside the cable. By watching these changes with a Distributed Acoustic Sensing system linked to one end of the cable, an attacker can recreate the original sound wave from the other end even over distances greater than 50 meters. Sound hits fiber. Fiber vibrates. Light shifts. AI reconstructs your conversation. No microphone. No bug. No trace. Why This Is Different From Everything Before: This attack transforms standard FTTH telecom fiber cables into passive, undetectable listening devices invisible to RF scanners and immune to ultrasonic jammers. Your traditional counter-surveillance gear will not work. The Device They Built: The researchers engineered a custom Sensory Receptor a hollow cylinder with 15 meters of optical fiber wound around it. Critically, this device can be disguised as an ordinary optical fiber box the same type routinely installed in homes and offices during FTTH deployments making it virtually indistinguishable from legitimate networking equipment. It looks exactly like what your ISP already installed. Who Is Most At Risk: → Corporate offices with FTTH connections → Government buildings and embassies → Law firms, banks, and financial institutions → Anyone having sensitive conversations near a fiber cable The Takeaway: Fiber optic cables have long been considered inherently secure. Resistant to RF emissions. Resistant to electromagnetic interference. That belief is now broken. The cable delivering your internet can also deliver your conversations to someone else entirely. Nobody installed a bug in your home. The infrastructure already was one.

Lydia Martinez, aged 19, operates a hydro press that develops pressure up to 4,500 tons and speeds production of parts for Consolidated Aircraft's B-24 Liberators, PBY Catalinas, and PB2Y Coronados, 1942. Hydraulic presses like this applied up to 4,500 tons of force, shaping large aluminum sections with consistency and speed, critical for mass production. During World War II, aircraft manufacturing scaled rapidly; the B-24 alone became the most-produced American aircraft of the war, with over 18,000 units built. As millions of men entered military service, women filled industrial roles across the U.S. workforce. By 1943, women made up roughly 37% of all workers, many in heavy manufacturing jobs previously closed to them. The Willow Run plant in Michigan, operated by Ford, produced B-24 bombers at a peak rate of one aircraft per hour, one of the fastest large-aircraft assembly operations ever achieved. © History Pictures #archaeohistories

Two sabotage attempts have been made in 3 months targeting a stretch of the Eastern Dedicated Freight Corridor in Punjab. #CutTheClutter looks at the DFC — one of India’s most ambitious infrastructure & logistics projects — explains its strategic importance & traces its journey from 2005, when it was approved. 2. DFC is a high-capacity, high-speed rail corridor built exclusively for freight. No passenger trains are allowed. We have 2: The Eastern DFC & the Western DFC, which together span 2,843 km across 9 states & 77 districts. This has greatly improved India’s logistics timings. For example, a normal goods train would take 3 days from Mumbai to Delhi. Now, with the DFC, it takes 48 hours. 3. Eastern DFC is from Sonnagar (Bihar) to Sahnewal (Punjab) & Western DFC is from Dadri (UP) to Mumbai. DFCs has its own stations linked to highways so heavy goods containers can be emptied quickly & do not clutter existing railway stations. The Eastern DFC has, in fact, made a huge difference in the transportation of coal — 68% of all freight transported. 4. Currently, the average tonnage a freight train carries in India is 5,400 tons (global average is 20,000-37,000 tons). So, heavy items like cement, steel, FMCG goods, automobiles, auto parts, and agricultural goods suffer delays. In 1950, railways carried 68% of India’s freight. By 2021-22, that fell to 26%, with highways taking over — at higher cost, clogged roads & pollution. Now, DFC aims to reverse that trend by pulling freight back to rail. 5. More corridors have already been approved: · The 2,155km East-West Corridor — from Dankuni (West Bengal) to Surat (Gujarat) · The 1,115km North-South Corridor — from Itarsi (Madhya Pradesh) to Vijaywada (Andhra) · The 975km East Coast Corridor — from Kharagpur (West Bengal) to Vijaywada (Andhra) · And 538km which could not be done with Eastern DFC. This is being done in 2 phases — about 400km from Sonnagar to Andal & 163km from Andal to Dankuni 6. And, finally, some exciting developments. India now has its longest & most powerful freight train — Rudrastra, which is 4.5km long with 7 engines. On August 7, 2025, it set a record by hauling 25,488 tons. Another is Super Vasuki, which is 3.5km long & hauled 25,962 tons. 7. Russia parks its rarest fighter jets deep in the Urals to keep them safe. That isn't working anymore. Ukrainian drones reached the Shagol airbase in Chelyabinsk Oblast on 25 April — 1,700 km from the border — and damaged several Su-57 stealth fighters and a Su-34 fighter-bomber, the General Staff confirmed this week. Russia has fewer than 30 Su-57s in service. The aircraft was meant to anchor Russia's export pitch to foreign buyers as a fifth-generation stealth fighter. After Ukrainian pilots neutralized its early combat appearances, Russia pulled it back from active operations over Ukraine — and kept the surviving fleet at bases the Kremlin assumed were beyond Ukrainian drone range. Science communicator Hank Green launched a specialized website that organizes every publicly released photo from the #ArtemisII mission into an interactive, live timeline. Located at artemistimeline(dot)com, the site syncs each image with the crew's official mission schedule and the real-time position of the Orion spacecraft during its 10 day journey around the Moon. By utilizing EXIF metadata from NASA's Flickr archives and trajectory data from public APIs, the platform allows users to see exactly where the crew was when a specific photograph was captured. Green utilized AI tools to assist with the massive data correlation required to align thousands of images with the spacecraft's orbital path. Source: artemistimeline.com

What happened on day 4⃣ of #CHEMEXGRULAC? Medical teams wearing personal protective equipment trained through realistic scenarios simulating emergency medical care in a chemical incident, where rapid assessment and life-saving interventions are critical. Specialised training mannequins — including a pregnant patient exposed to toxic chemicals and able to communicate symptoms — added a high level of realism. The day concluded with a full patient decontamination procedure, a vital step to prevent secondary contamination, protect healthcare workers, and ensure patients can be safely transferred for further treatment. First responders focused on collecting samples in the hot zone: a critical skill to quickly identify the chemical agent involved. Rapid identification allows teams to contain the hazard, guide medical treatment, and protect both responders and the public. UAE's decision of Pakistani Citizens' deportation in Pakistan's style 🔴 There have been reports suggesting that authorities in the United Arab Emirates have taken measures affecting Pakistani citizens. While the details and scope of such actions can vary, situations like these often raise broader concerns about how government policies impact ordinary people. As a principle, government decisions whether driven by security concerns, political differences, or policy changes should be implemented in a manner that minimizes harm to peaceful and law-abiding individuals. Deportation may be justified in cases where a person is proven to have violated the law or posed a genuine threat to the host country. However, when individuals who have lived, worked, and contributed positively to a society are affected without due consideration of their circumstances, the consequences can be deeply distressing and disruptive. 👉 This issue resonates strongly on a personal level. I have experienced a similar situation when the #Pakistani government forcibly deported us who had lived peacefully in Pakistan for decades many for over 45 years. These individuals were hardworking, law-abiding members of society, yet they were expelled under extremely harsh conditions, often without the opportunity to take their belongings or secure their livelihoods. The policy, largely driven by political tensions with the #Taliban government, resulted in widespread suffering among ordinary people who had no involvement in such conflicts. Such actions raise serious humanitarian concerns. The forced displacement of long-settled communities, particularly without adequate safeguards, due process, or respect for human dignity, represents a deeply troubling precedent. It highlights the urgent need for policies that balance national interests with compassion, fairness, and adherence to fundamental human rights. Ultimately, regardless of nationality, ordinary people should not bear the burden of political disagreements or policy shifts. Humane and just treatment must remain at the core of any government action, especially when it affects vulnerable populations who have already endured significant hardship. #UAE

At the recent roundtable on "Protected Cultivation as a Strategy for Crop Diversification and Income Growth", #ICRIER brought together policymakers, researchers, farmers and industry experts to discuss pathways for scaling high-value agriculture in India, and the consensus was clear that the future of Indian agriculture lies beyond wheat and paddy. Setting the context, Dr #AshokGulati, Distinguished Professor, ICRIER, framed the central paradox: if polyhouses can deliver 3–5x higher productivity and 30–50x better income returns than traditional paddy-wheat systems, why does adoption remain near zero? The discussions pointed to what needs to shift: ✅Starting with clustered, high-potential geographies — Bassi-Boraj in Rajasthan and Kutch in Gujarat show what's possible ✅Building financing models that match the investment horizon of polyhouse farming ✅Strengthening FPOs to give smallholders collective market power ✅ Investing in cold chains, logistics, and post-harvest infrastructure The event also marked the launch of ICRIER's report "Augmenting Farmers' Income through Protected Cultivation", authored by Dr Ranjana Roy and Dr #AshokGulati, which makes the case that the shift from cereal-based systems to high-value horticulture won't happen through technology alone, it requires coordinated policy support, better credit access, and a fundamental rethink of how farming systems are designed. Protected cultivation holds transformative potential. It will also boost spiritual and cultural tourism in Ladakh.

'महालक्ष्मी सरस'मुळे बचत गटांच्या उत्पादनांना योग्य बाजारपेठ व ग्राहक मिळून महिलांना अपेक्षित लाभ मिळत असल्याचे मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांनी सांगितले. बचत गटांच्या उत्पादनांमध्ये आता केवळ गुणवत्ता नव्हे, तर आकर्षक पॅकेजिंग, उत्पादनाची माहिती, पोषणमूल्ये आणि वापर याबाबतची सविस्तर माहिती दिली जात असून त्यामुळे बचत गटांची स्पर्धात्मकता वाढली आहे. बचत गट आता मोठ्या बाजारपेठेत स्पर्धा करण्यास सक्षम झाले आहेत, असा विश्वास मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी व्यक्त केला. याशिवाय, 'उमेद' अंतर्गत उभारण्यात आलेला डिजिटल प्लॅटफॉर्म हा एक व्हर्च्युअल मार्केटप्लेस म्हणून विकसित होत असून, ई-कॉमर्सच्या वाढत्या प्रवाहात महिलांना स्थान मिळवून देण्यासाठी तो महत्त्वाचा ठरत आहे. या प्लॅटफॉर्मवर आज 1000 उत्पादनांचे ऑनबोर्डींग करण्यात आले असल्याचे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी सांगितले. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी या उपक्रमाच्या माध्यमातून राज्यातील महिला सक्षमीकरणाला अधिक चालना मिळेल, असा विश्वास व्यक्त केला. उमेदच्या माध्यमातून महिला बचत गटांसाठी योजना तयार करण्यात येईल. त्यामार्फत महिला बचत गटांना नर्सरी उभारणीसाठी निधी उपलब्ध करून दिला जाईल, याद्वारे महाराष्ट्राच्या 300 कोटी वृक्ष लागवडीच्या संकल्पात महिला मोठ्या प्रमाणात सहभागी होतील आणि पर्यावरण संवर्धनात हातभार लावतील, असे मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांनी सांगितले. यावेळी मंत्री मंगलप्रभात लोढा, मंत्री जयकुमार गोरे, राज्यमंत्री योगेश कदम, मुंबईच्या महापौर रितू तावडे व इतर मान्यवर उपस्थित होते. @narendramodi @Dev_Fadnavis @MPLodha @Jaykumar_Gore @iYogeshRKadam @TawdeRitu #Maharashtra #DevendraFadnavis #Mumbai #MahalaxmiSaras2026

ATF की कीमत बढ़ने से फ्लाइट ऑपरेशन की लागत एयरलाइंस कंपनियों की कमर तोड़ रही हैं. एयर इंडिया ने ऑपरेशनल खर्च के बढ़ते बोझ को कम करने के लिए उड़ानों की संख्या घटा दी है. रोजाना 100 उड़ानों को रद्द कर दिया है. घरेलू और अंतरराष्ट्रीय दोनों ही रूट्स पर उड़ानों में कटौती कर दी गई है. जेट फ्यूल के दाम बढ़ने से एयरलाइंस कंपनियों पर आर्थिक बोझ बढ़ रहा है. युद्ध की वजह से एयर इंडिया की बढ़ी मुश्किल फ्यूल प्राइस में बढ़ोतरी के चलते एयर इंडिया ने अपनी उड़ानों की संख्या घटा दी है. अभी एयर इंडिया के रोजाना 1100 से ज्यादा फ्लाइट्स उड़ान भरते हैं, लेकिन अब इसमें कटौती की जा रही है, ताकि घाटे को कम किया जा सके. माना जा रहा है कि यूरोप, अमेरिका, ऑस्ट्रेलिया और सिंगापुर रूट्स पर फ्लाइट्स कम किए जाएंगे. घरेलू रूट्स पर भी कुछ फ्लाइट्स घटाए जाने का प्लान है. कितना बढ़ा ATF का रेट्स जेट फ्यूल के दाम लगातार बढ़ रहे हैं. घरेलू कैरियर में एटीएफ के दाम में 25 फीसदी तक की बढ़ोतरी हो गई है और यह 1,04,927.18 प्रति किलोलीटर पर पहुंच चुकी है. एयरलाइंस पहले से ही 20 हजार करोड़ रुपये के घाटे में चल रही है. एटीएफ के दाम बढ़ने से ये आंकड़ा और बढ़ता जा रहा है. अमेरिका की स्पिरिट एयरलाइन ने बंद किया कारोबार ईरान होर्मुज खोलने के लिए तैयार है, लेकिन ट्रंप अब मनमानी कर रहे हैं. वो ईरान को अपनी शर्तों पर युद्ध में पीछे धकेल रहे हैं. जिसकी वजह से होर्मुज अब तक बंद है. होर्मुज संकट की वजह से तेल महंगा हो रहा है. ATF फ्यूल के दाम बढ़ने से अमेरिकी एयरलाइन बंद हो गया. एविएशन सेक्टर में इस युद्ध का घातक असर दिखने लगा है. बढ़ती फ्यूल कॉस्ट की वजह से अमेरिका की लो-कॉस्ट एयरलाइन स्पिरिट एयरलाइंस को अपना कारोबार बंद करना पड़ा है. 34 साल बाद एयरलाइंस ने अपना कारोबार बंद करने का ऐलान कर दिया है. ईंधन की लागत बढ़ने से कंपनी लगातार घाटे जा रही थी. पहले भी दो बार दिवालिया होने के कगार पर पहुंच गई थी. इस बार वो तेल के बढ़ते दामों के दबाव को झेल नहीं पाई और ऑपरेशन बंद करना पड़ा है.एयरलाइन बंद होने की वजह से 17000 लोगों की नौकरी चली गई है. #IranUSAWar #AirIndiaFlight #Flight #USAFLight #Fuel #ZeeNews

Development finance must be more disciplined and catalytic, anchored in clearer guidance on domestic resource mobilization, stronger private capital mobilization and the scaling of remittances and diaspora investment as a reliable channel for rural development. We also discussed how to reduce fragmentation and use concessional resources more strategically, through country-led platforms and stronger accountability. Rising macroeconomic pressures are affecting the poorest countries hardest, especially economies reliant on agriculture and rural sectors. This is where @IFAD focuses its investments at the first mile, working to de-risk rural economies and unlock sustainable growth. At the recent roundtable on "Protected Cultivation as a Strategy for Crop Diversification and Income Growth", #ICRIER brought together policymakers, researchers, farmers and industry experts to discuss pathways for scaling high-value agriculture in India, and the consensus was clear that the future of Indian agriculture lies beyond wheat and paddy. Setting the context, Dr #AshokGulati, Distinguished Professor, ICRIER, framed the central paradox: if polyhouses can deliver 3–5x higher productivity and 30–50x better income returns than traditional paddy-wheat systems, why does adoption remain near zero? The discussions pointed to what needs to shift: ✅Starting with clustered, high-potential geographies — Bassi-Boraj in Rajasthan and Kutch in Gujarat show what's possible ✅Building financing models that match the investment horizon of polyhouse farming ✅Strengthening FPOs to give smallholders collective market power ✅ Investing in cold chains, logistics, and post-harvest infrastructure The event also marked the launch of ICRIER's report "Augmenting Farmers' Income through Protected Cultivation", authored by Dr Ranjana Roy and Dr #AshokGulati, which makes the case that the shift from cereal-based systems to high-value horticulture won't happen through technology alone, it requires coordinated policy support, better credit access, and a fundamental rethink of how farming systems are designed. Protected cultivation holds transformative potential. Unlocking it will take aligning technology, markets, and policy together. 🔗 Read the full report: icrier.org/publications/augm… #Agriculture #FoodSecurity #ProtectedCultivation #PolicyResearch #ICRIER #AgriTech #FarmerIncome

Keralam CMO says, "State Cabinet has decided to provide financial assistance in connection with the Valparai accident, in which a vehicle carrying teachers, staff members, and some family members of Pang Government UP School overturned. A compensation of Rs 10 lakh will be provided to the families of five deceased persons who did not have insurance coverage. The other deceased teachers were covered by insurance. The government will also bear the medical expenses of Mohammed Shahad, son of a deceased teacher, Masneen, daughter of another teacher, and the vehicle driver Mohammed Fahis, who were injured in the accident. The Cabinet further decided that for those having insurance coverage, any treatment expenses incurred beyond the insurance amount will also be reimbursed from the Chief Minister’s Distress Relief Fund. The Cabinet also decided to ratify the order creating 14 additional posts for the smooth functioning of the 12th Pay Commission."

At the recent roundtable on "Protected Cultivation as a Strategy for Crop Diversification and Income Growth", #ICRIER brought together policymakers, researchers, farmers and industry experts to discuss pathways for scaling high-value agriculture in India, and the consensus was clear that the future of Indian agriculture lies beyond wheat and paddy. Setting the context, Dr #AshokGulati, Distinguished Professor, ICRIER, framed the central paradox: if polyhouses can deliver 3–5x higher productivity and 30–50x better income returns than traditional paddy-wheat systems, why does adoption remain near zero? The discussions pointed to what needs to shift: ✅Starting with clustered, high-potential geographies — Bassi-Boraj in Rajasthan and Kutch in Gujarat show what's possible ✅Building financing models that match the investment horizon of polyhouse farming ✅Strengthening FPOs to give smallholders collective market power ✅ Investing in cold chains, logistics, and post-harvest infrastructure The event also marked the launch of ICRIER's report "Augmenting Farmers' Income through Protected Cultivation", authored by Dr Ranjana Roy and Dr #AshokGulati, which makes the case that the shift from cereal-based systems to high-value horticulture won't happen through technology alone, it requires coordinated policy support, better credit access, and a fundamental rethink of how farming systems are designed. Protected cultivation holds transformative potential. Unlocking it will take aligning technology, markets, and policy together. 🔗 Read the full report: icrier.org/publications/augm… #Agriculture #FoodSecurity #ProtectedCultivation #PolicyResearch #ICRIER #AgriTech #FarmerIncome

🕯 Пам’яті Героя України Біжана Шаропова Біжан був талановитим науковцем, кандидатом біологічних наук та викладачем Києво-Могилянської академії. Попри таджицьке походження, він завжди називав себе українцем, адже саме тут виріс і сформувався як особистість. Біжан дивовижним чином поєднував науку, викладання та творчість — він писав фантастику та був співавтором збірки ветеранів АТО «Голос війни». Військовий шлях почав ще під час АТО у складі батальйону «Айдар». Після 24 лютого 2022 року науковець знову став на захист країни. Разом із побратимами він виконував надскладні завдання на Харківщині: підривав мости, щоб зупинити просування ворога, та корегував вогонь артилерії по колонах окупантів. У квітні 2022 року поблизу селища Борова підрозділ Біжана потрапив в оточення. Попри пошкоджену техніку, воїни прийняли свій останній бій. Тривалий час захисник вважався зниклим безвісти, доки восени його тіло не знайшли у братській могилі. 📝 Підготовлено Українським національним агентством Укрінформ спільно з Українським інститутом національної памʼяті та онлайн-медіа Міноборони України АрміяInform.

This week we observed a complex proximity event involving Russian satellites: COSMOS 2581, 2582, 2583, and Object F (a subsatellite released by 2583). The highlight: COSMOS 2581 and 2583 achieved a closest approach of ~3 meters on 28 April at UTC, with near-zero relative velocity. This wasn't a coincidental pass — COSMOS 2583 performed several fine maneuvers to maintain this tight configuration. Meanwhile, COSMOS 2582 trailed the formation at sub-100 km range, while Object F passed within 15 km of 2582 and within 10 km of 2581 — neither maneuvered. For context: in late 2025 to now, we tracked these same COSMOS satellites performing 3-object RPO. These satellites launched 5 February 2025. PRESS RELEASE Family Expresses Gratitude To All Who Participated in Buhari’s Burial and Prayers The most senior member of the Buhari family, the family of the late President, Muhammadu Buhari, Malam Mamman Daura has, on behalf of the family expressed gratitude to President Bola Ahmed Tinubu and his wife, the First Lady, Senator Remi Tinubu for their role and that of Government of the Federation before, and after the passing of the former president. “It is truly comforting to receive such support from the President and the Vice President, Kashim Shettima, who went to the United Kingdom, and here in Daura, for the days he and the ministers during the mourning period. These have instilled confidence in all of us to face this loss with courage. “We are deeply grateful to the President on his thoughtful gestures in declaring a public holiday and renaming the University of Maiduguri after Buhari. “Our gratitude also goes to leaders of the various countries around the globe who either came in person, sent representatives, sent letters, or placed personal telephone calls to commiserate with us. Of special note were those of the King of England, King Charles III, the Secretary General of the United Nations, the Deputy Secretary General, Amina Mohammed, the Chairman of the African Union, and that of the Committee of Heads of State and Government of ECOWAS countries, and our former Head of State, Abdulsalami Abubakar. “Muhammadu Buhari’s demise is an irreparable loss and its pain is beyond words, but the general reaction and kind expressions give us the strength to cope with the loss of our esteemed family member and former leader of the country. “The family is equally grateful to Vice President Kashim Shettima in his own person and his wife, and to all state governors, especially those of Katsina, the host governor Dr Dikko Umar Radda; Professor Babagana Umara Zulum of Borno State and all those who visited us in the UK and Daura from Adamawa, Kano, Kwara, Lagos, Kaduna, Imo, Nasarawa, Bauchi, Sokoto, Kebbi as well as the several former governors, including Dr Peter Obi for their compassionate words of condolence. Your empathy has touched our hearts deeply, and we are truly grateful for your kindness. "We express our deep appreciations to former Vice Presidents Atiku Abubakar, Architect Namadi Sambo, Professor Yemi Osinbajo, and Ambassador Babagana Kingibe as well as to the President of Senate, Godswill Akpabio, the Speaker, House of Representatives, Honorable Tajuddeen Abbas, Deputy Senate President Barau Jibrin and the other leaders and members of the National and State Assemblies. “We do sincerely thank the Secretary to the Government of the Federation, SGF, Senator George Akume and his predecessor in office, Boss Mustapha, the current Chief of Staff, Honorable Femi Gbajabiamila and his predecessor, Professor Ibrahim Gambari, former and serving members of the cabinet in both administrations for their activities in these events and their comforting words. “We are very pleased with the amazing gestures of our traditional leaders, notably the Sultan of Sokoto, the Shehu of Borno, the Emir of Gwandu and the host emirs of Katsina and Daura, as well as the various emirs and chiefs from all over Nigeria and the neighboring countries who came in person or sent representatives. “We have been honored by the large turnout of religious leaders, Islamic, Christian and of other faiths, community leaders, women, youth and politicians of various leanings whose surge in Daura was both challenging and reassuring. “The family in Daura is also thanking past and serving security and intelligence, police and military leaders, permanent secretaries, and the rank and file civil servants, community groups and associations, civil society, and the media of communications. 1/2

За останні 3 роки та 8 місяців (44 місяці або 1350 днів) ворог захопив 23% Донецької області, а під контролем Сил Оборони України залишається 22.6% Хоч динаміка окупації Донеччини залишається у розрізі щоденних оновлень доволі жвавою, але в контексті контролю над усієї областю — дуже повільною. До повномасштабного вторгнення бойовики терористичних проросійських угруповань контролювали приблизно 32% області. За перші 40 днів вторгнення через провал оборони на півдні України та оточення Маріуполя, кацап зумів захопити ще 22.4% Донеччини. Після цього темпи просування спали, адже Сили Оборони стали від Великої Новосілки до Вугледару, а кацап стирався у штурмах ДонУРу (Донецького укріпленого району). Історичний факт, що німецький Вермахт за неповні 47 місяців умудрився від Західного Бугу дійти до Москви та Сталінграду, а також повернутися в Берлін. Натомість "друга армія світу" за майже аналогічний період дійшла від Донецька до Покровська. Яким чином американські партнери вважають такий "черепаховий наступ" козирем — зрозуміти складно. Хоча, звісно, і ми не в змозі за нинішньої конфігурації сил звільнити всі міжнародно визнані території. В цілому, якщо великих змін не буде, то для окупації всієї Донеччини кацапам треба буде не менше 3 років. І в чому тут козир — пишіть у коментарях до публікації. Video

A 2005 state-designed worm designed to corrupt physics simulations sat undetected on VirusTotal for nearly a decade. Fast16, intercepted executable files at the kernel level and silently rewrote floating-point calculations to make them produce slightly wrong answers. Targets: high-precision engineering suites used for structural analysis, crash simulations, and physical process modeling, including LS-DYNA, a tool cited in reports on Iran's nuclear weapons research. The sabotage vector relied on deployment of the driver across a network via worm, corrupting calculations on every machine, and eliminating the possibility of cross-checking results against a clean system. Stuxnet got the documentary. Fast16 got twenty years of nothing. sentinelone.com/labs/fast16-…

En el Día del Trabajador, un hito histórico: comienza la aplicación provisional del acuerdo Unión Europea–Mercosur tras 25 años de negociaciones. Más integración, multilateralismo y comercio basado en reglas, con potencial para impulsar empleo y desarrollo en ambas regiones. Se abre una nueva etapa de oportunidades.

Ministro Mauro Vieira representou o Pr. Lula em videoconferência que marcou a entrada em vigor do Acordo Mercosul-UE. Participaram o Presidente do Conselho Europeu, António Costa, da Comissão Europeia, Ursula von der Leyen, 🇵🇾 Santiago Peña, 🇦🇷 Javier Milei e 🇺🇾 Yamandu Orsi

Hoy, 1º de mayo de 2026, da comienzo la aplicación provisional del Acuerdo de Comercio entre el #MERCOSUR y la Unión Europea 🇪🇺. Tras casi tres décadas de negociaciones, las economías de ambos bloques enfrentarán desde ahora menos barreras al comercio y la inversión. El Acuerdo MS-UE permite la configuración de la mayor área económica del planeta, que incluye a más de 700 millones de consumidores y representa la cuarta parte de la producción económica global. El Acuerdo con la Unión Europea es además el mayor acuerdo comercial firmado por el MERCOSUR en su historia, y refleja una voluntad compartida por ambos bloques: construir un espacio de cooperación basado en reglas claras, previsibilidad y confianza. Nuestro gobierno fue el primero en completar los procedimientos de aprobación del Acuerdo por considerarlo un paso fundamental en la reinserción internacional de nuestro país que consolida la cooperación estratégica con la Unión Europea y sus países, lo que demuestra la firme convicción de que la integración regional y global de nuestra economía son palancas claves del desarrollo argentino. Comienzan a reducirse aranceles y a eliminarse barreras, abriendo una nueva etapa en la relación comercial entre ambas regiones. Pasamos de negociar a implementar: el desafío es traducir compromisos en resultados concretos, ampliando nuestras oportunidades productivas y fortaleciendo la economía. 🇦🇷🤝🇪🇺 — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/pabloquirno/status/2050216830883483958#m

Con il Piano Casa mettiamo in campo fino a 10 miliardi di euro per arrivare a rendere disponibili, nei prossimi 10 anni, oltre 100 mila alloggi popolari o a prezzi calmierati. Interveniamo per recuperare fino a 60 mila case popolari oggi non utilizzabili, così da assegnarle a cittadini e famiglie che ne hanno bisogno. Apriamo anche agli investimenti privati nell’edilizia abitativa, con procedure più veloci e semplificate, ma a una condizione chiara: almeno il 70% degli alloggi realizzati dovrà essere destinato a chi è in difficoltà, con prezzi di vendita o di affitto ridotti di almeno il 30% rispetto ai valori di mercato. È così che vogliamo dare una risposta concreta non solo alle fasce più fragili, ma anche a tanti italiani che lavorano, studiano, pagano le tasse e che oggi, soprattutto nelle grandi città, non riescono comunque a permettersi una casa. Grazie al Ministro Salvini, al Ministro Foti, alle Regioni e ai Comuni per la collaborazione.

Anti-Corruption Branch, GNCTD arrested 9 Owners/Directors/Associated persons of Coaching Institutes in Delhi. These institutes had been empanelled in Jai Bhim Mukhyamantri Pratibha Vikas Yojana in 2018-19 Coaching Fee for institute and stipend for students was to be paid to the Institute by Deptt. of SC & ST. In 2019-20, this Yojana was re-introduced with some amendments i.e. ST, OBC, EWS categories were also added and this time 38 more Institutes were empanelled. Overall around 22,000 students were enrolled in both phases. Investigation also revealed that these Institutes had obtained Rs. 37.20 Crores under this Yojana. It was mandatory for all Institutes to maintain a separate Bank Account for this Yojana but it was not complied with at all. Investigation also revealed that the lists of students, which had been submitted by institutes for seeking funds, from Govt Ex-chequer, were containing names of several students in two or more Institutes. Thereafter, a large no. of students were called to join investigation. They narrated that they had not sought admission in another institute, meaning thereby that forged documents regarding admissions of students in this Yojana were created and produced by Institutes for claiming funds from Govt. DSCST Officials also did not check/regulate the flowing of funds in wrong hands. It also came upon that stipend amounts received by Institutes had not been disbursed to students in several cases. Investigation also revealed that some of the Institutes had sent their students to local tuition centres for coaching, which was also a major violation. Owners/Directors/Proprietors/Runners of Local Tuition Centres were given several opportunities to explain their version with substance but they could not put any substance thereto. Even some of the Institutes transferred stipends in accounts of students, after registration of case. 9 accused persons have been arrested in this case on 29.04.2026. On 30.04.26 all of them were produced in Spl. Court and sent to 14 days JC. Income Certificates & Caste Certificates produced by Institutes to DSCST are also being verified from Revenue Authorities. Role of other Institutes and concerned officials of Department of SC/ST is still under probe.

Розпочинаємо реформу армії. Протягом квітня були погоджені ключові напрямки реформи: військове командування та уряд визначили формулу змін. Зараз, у травні, відбудеться погодження всіх ключових деталей. У червні реформа стартує, і вже в червні повинні бути перші результати, зокрема у сфері фінансового забезпечення солдатів, сержантів та командирів Сил оборони України. Перше: поставив завдання відчутно збільшити грошове забезпечення з урахуванням принципу справедливості, а саме – бойові завдання на першій лінії, реальний бойовий та управлінський досвід, ефективність військовослужбовця повинні гарантувати збільшення виплат. Мінімальний рівень має бути не менше ніж 30 тисяч гривень для тилових посад. Для бойових позицій – більше в рази. Для українських командирів, бойових сержантів та офіцерів – достойний та відчутно підвищений рівень виплат. Друге: особлива увага – піхотинцям. Український піхотинець, який тримає на собі лінію фронту, має відчувати, що наша держава реально його поважає. Доручив забезпечити впровадження спеціальних контрактів саме для наших піхотинців із виплатами в рамках 250–400 тисяч гривень у залежності від виконання бойових завдань. Третє: будуть змінені підходи до комплектації наших підрозділів особовим складом та управління людьми. Доручив посилити контрактну систему в Силах оборони таким чином, щоб завдяки розширенню контрактної складової забезпечити визначені терміни служби й можливість – починаючи вже з цього року – поетапного звільнення зі служби тих, хто був мобілізований раніше, на основі чітких часових критеріїв. Доручив військовому командуванню та міністру оборони України обговорити реалізацію реформи з нашими бойовими командирами та врахувати їхні пропозиції в роботі над деталями реформи. На наступний тиждень очікую доповідь по конкретних кроках у реалізації реформи, зокрема щодо графіка підвищених виплат, починаючи з червня, та системи оновлених контрактів. Слава Україні!

In June, the reform will begin – and the first results must already be delivered in June, particularly in the area of financial support for soldiers, sergeants, and commanders of the Defense Forces of Ukraine. First: I have set the task of significantly increasing pay based on the principle of fairness. Specifically, combat missions on the frontline, real combat and leadership experience, and the effectiveness of a servicemember must guarantee increased pay. The minimum level must be at least 30,000 hryvnias for non-combat positions. For combat positions, it should be several times higher. For Ukrainian commanders, combat sergeants, and officers, pay must be dignified and significantly higher. Second: special attention to infantry. A Ukrainian infantryman who holds the frontline must feel that our state truly respects him. I have instructed that special contracts be introduced specifically for our infantry, with payments in the range of 250,000 to 400,000 hryvnias depending on the execution of combat missions. Third: approaches to staffing our units and managing personnel will be changed. I have instructed that the contract system in the Defense Forces be strengthened so that, by expanding the contract component, defined service duration terms are ensured and – starting already this year – a phased discharge from service becomes possible for those who were mobilized earlier, based on clear time-based criteria. I have instructed the military command and the Minister of Defense of Ukraine to discuss the implementation of the reform with our combat commanders and to take their proposals into account in the work on the reform’s details. Next week, I expect a report on concrete steps to implement the reform – including the schedule for increased payments starting in June and the system of updated contracts. Glory to Ukraine!
